messages:
Kaitlyn (People Ops): Thanks again for joining the all-hands today — following up with a single thread for the leveling/comp/benefits questions we didn't get to. I'll answer the ones I can and loop in folks who need to weigh in. Ask follow-ups here. :wave:

Devon (Eng): quick one — if my manager submits a promotion now, is the raise retroactive to the start of the review period or just from the promotion date?

Kaitlyn (People Ops): Great q. Standard practice: promotion salary adjustments are applied effective the start of the next payroll cycle after approval. We can do a retroactive pay adjustment back to the start of the review period only if the manager requests it within 30 days of the approval and Finance signs off. Exceptions (e.g., backdating > 30 days) require Exec approval.

Devon (Eng): ok — is the 30-day window measured from manager notification or from the payroll change date?

Kaitlyn (People Ops): From the official promotion approval timestamp (when People Ops marks it approved in the HR system). We try to keep approvals and payroll changes within the same month where possible to avoid manual adjustments.

Priya (E Staff): calibration update — Eng calibration is scheduled for Tue 4/12, and we'll lock final levels by EOD 4/15. If anyone believes a proposed change was missed, email me + Kaitlyn within 3 business days after 4/15 and we'll reopen the case for review.

Kaitlyn (People Ops): Adding that appeals should include a short rationale and manager notes. We don't re-run full cycles for single appeals; expect a focused review.

Mike (Recruiting): small ask — when a role's level changes mid-open-search, do we update the req band immediately or post-calibration? We've had candidates ask.

Kaitlyn (People Ops): If a role’s official level changes during a live search, Recruiting should: 1) update the req to the new band, 2) flag active candidates so Recruiters can share updated comp bands, and 3) loop in Hiring Manager + Finance for offer templates. For offers already extended but unsigned, offers may be adjusted per the new band (manager + Finance sign-off).

Devon (Eng): parental leave question from last row — do managers still submit the temporary pay adjustment for reduced hours, or is that auto-handled?

Kaitlyn (People Ops): Good callout. For reduced-hours/part-time parental arrangements, managers submit a change request in the HR portal and select the "temporary FTE change" flow. Benefits/payouts remain as per the parental policy. See our benefits page: https://intranet.redwood.com/benefits/parental-leave. If you hit any payroll edge cases, tag @HR-Bot-payroll and we'll triage.

Ava (CEO): One small leadership note — we want to make promotion visibility clearer to ICs. Kaitlyn, can People Ops publish a short one-pager on the promotion timeline and typical outcomes? 1 pager, bullets, link to appeal flow.

Kaitlyn (People Ops): On it. Will publish a one-pager and a short FAQ by end of week. I'll post the doc here when live. :thumbsup:

HR-Bot: Reminder: calibration meeting for Eng posted on calendar at 4/12 10:00-12:00. Materials due to #people-ops by 4/10.

Devon (Eng): Thanks — that's super helpful. Appreciate the clarity.

Kaitlyn (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If anything else pops up, drop it here or DM me. We'll keep this thread pinned for the week.
